contents.content:
Bangalore is Karnataka’s main city. It has IT jobs, nice weather, and  vibrant nightlife. It has many kinds of food, like old South Indian and new mixed food. You can eat at small shops or big restaurants on the road. Bangalore has yummy food for all to like. 

Table of Contents

Key Takeaways

  • Bangalore has a diverse and rich food scene, offering a variety of cuisines and dishes for every taste and budget.
  • The top 10 affordable places to eat in Bangalore are Taaza Thindi, Brahmin’s Coffee Bar, Shri Sagar (C.T.R), Vidyarthi Bhavan, Veena Store, Food Street / Thindi Bheedi, Kota Kachori, Khan saheb grills and rolls, Quattro, and Biriyani Zone.
  • These places offer some of the best and most popular dishes in Bangalore, such as dosa, idli, vada, filter coffee, paratha, chaat,kachori, pizza, pasta, and more.
  • These places are also known for their quality, service, ambiance, and ratings.

Location-Jayanagar
Cuisine- South Indian
Price Range- ₹50-₹100
Rating- 4.6/5
Bangalore is famous for its food, and Taaza Thindi in Jayanagar offers some of the best. They're known for their delicious dosas, soft idlis, crispy vadas, and strong filter coffee. Everything is fresh and hot, served on banana leaves. They're quick, clean, and affordable, with most dishes under 50 rupees. Try a masala dosa for 40 rupees, an idli for 10 rupees, or other tasty dosas like set dosa and rava dosa.

Location- Basavanagudi 
Cuisine-South Indian 
Price Range- ₹50 -₹100
Rating- 4.5/5 
Brahmin’s Coffee Bar in Bangalore is a popular spot for Breakfast. They offer soft idlis, crunchy vadas, and delicious chutney. Their strong coffee is perfect for starting your day. Though it's often crowded, they serve quickly and efficiently. The food is simple, tasty, and affordable compared to other places.

Location-  Malleshwaram
Cuisine-South Indian 
Price- ₹50 - ₹150 
Rating- 4.4/5 
A famous place for butter masala dosa, benne dosa, and filter coffee. The place is old and rustic, but has a charm of its own. The dosas are crispy, buttery, and delicious, and come with a generous amount of potato masala and coconut chutney. The filter coffee is also smooth and aromatic. A must-try place for dosa lovers.

Location-  Basavanagudi
Cuisine-South Indian 
Price Range- ₹50 - ₹100
Rating- 4.2/5  
Bangalore has an old restaurant called Vidyarthi Bhavan. They've been around since 1943, making delicious dosas, idlis, vadas, and coffee for many people. It's often crowded, but the workers are helpful and fast. Their dosas are big and crispy, served with yummy toppings and chutneys. The idlis and vadas are soft and tasty too. They also have strong coffee that wakes you up A place to experience the nostalgia and heritage of Bangalore.

Location- Malleshwaram
Cuisine-South Indian 
Price Range- ₹50 -₹100
Rating-4.3/5
Bangalore's Veena Store is like eating at home. They make tasty idlis, crispy vadas, warm pongal, and upma for breakfast. Everything's fresh and hot, with different chutneys and sambar. Their coffee is yummy and sweet too! It's a small place, but perfect for a delicious and filling breakfast.

Location-  VV Puram
Cuisine-Street Food
Price Range-₹50 - ₹100
Rating-4.1/5 
Thindi Bheedi is a food street with many small shops selling food. You'll find lots of tasty snacks and sweets available there. They have popular dishes like dosa, chaat, and pav bhaji, plus other things like momos and sandwiches. The food is delicious and affordable, cooked fresh each day. The street is busy and lively, making it a fun place to visit with friends or family to try different foods.

Location-  Koramangala
Cuisine- North Indian 
Price Range-  ₹50 - ₹150
Rating-4.2/5 
This small shop sells tasty snacks like kachoris and samosas filled with lentils, potatoes, onions, and sometimes even cheese. They're crispy, spicy, and delicious. They also have hot, sweet, and crunchy jalebis for a sweet treat. Feeling thirsty? Their thick, creamy lassis are perfect. This place is simple, but the food is good, especially if you like North Indian flavors. It's a good place to visit with friends and try different things.

Location-  Different Areas in Bangalore
Cuisine- North India, Mughalai
Price Range- ₹100 - ₹250
Rating-3.9/5
Khan Saheb serves yummy North Indian food, like rolls, kebabs, biryani, and drinks. They have many shops in Bangalore and one in Coimbatore. Their rolls and kebabs are famous for their variety and affordability. Popular items include the Mutton Sheek Roll, Veg Rolls, Keema Rolls, Paneer Rolls, and delicious Kababs. They also offer home delivery and takeaway, so you can enjoy their food at home or on the go.

Location-  Richmond Town
Cuisine- Mexican, Italian
Price Range- ₹200 - ₹500
Rating-4.4/5
Good  Italian food is available at this place, like pizzas, pasta, and sweets. It is warm and good for a special dinner. They make food with fresh things and cook nicely. Pizzas have cheese and are thin and crunchy. Pasta is not soft and has creamy things on it. Risottos have meat or vegetables and are yummy and full. Tiramisus have coffee and chocolate and are wet and soft.

Location-  Different Areas in Bangalore
Cuisine-Indian
Price Range- ₹200-₹400
Rating-4.0/5
This place has yummy biryanis. You will love their chicken tikka biryani with soft chicken and tasty spices. They also have paneer biryani for vegetarians. And they have more dishes, like kebabs, curries, and rotis. The prices are low and the portions are big. You can save more money with their combo offers.

Conclusion

Bangalore offers a vibrant and diverse culinary scene that caters to all tastes and budgets. From traditional South Indian delicacies to fusion dishes and international cuisines, the city has something to satisfy every palate. The top 10 affordable eateries mentioned, including Taaza Thindi, Brahmin’s Coffee Bar, Shri Sagar (C.T.R), Vidyarthi Bhavan, Veena Store, Food Street / Thindi Bheedi, Kota Kachori, Khan saheb Grills and rolls, Quattro, and Biriyani Zone, showcase the rich culinary heritage and flavors of Bangalore. Whether you're craving crispy dosas, aromatic filter coffee, spicy chaat, or creamy pasta, these establishments offer delicious options at pocket-friendly prices.

FAQS

Q: What are some of the best cheap eats in Bengaluru?
A: Some of the best cheap eats in Bengaluru are Taaza Thindi, Brahmin’s Coffee Bar, Shri Sagar (C.T.R), Vidyarthi Bhavan, Veena Store, Food Street / Thindi Bheedi, Kota Kachori,Khan saheb grills and rolls, Quattro, and  Biriyani Zone.
Q: What are some of the best moderately priced restaurants in Bengaluru?
A: Some of the best moderately priced restaurants in Bengaluru are Time Traveller, 46 Ounces Old Madras Road, Tiamo, 46 Ounces, Byg Brewski Brewing Company, Just Blr, The Whiskey Bar, Bengaluru Baking Company, WBG - Whitefield Bar and Grill, and Red Rhino Craft Brewery and Inspired Kitchen.
Q: What are some of the best budget-friendly restaurants near me in Bangalore?
A: Some of the best budget-friendly restaurants near you in Bangalore are Mainland China, Chutney Chang, Hammered, Maiyas, Cafe Palmyra, The Druid Garden, Caraway Kitchen, and Kaapi Katte.
Q: What are some of the best cuisines to try in Bangalore?
A: Bangalore is a cosmopolitan city that offers a variety of cuisines to suit every taste and preference. Some of the most popular cuisines to try in Bangalore are Indian, Chinese, Italian, Mexican, Continental, and Mediterranean.
Q: What are some of the best dishes to try in Bangalore?
A: Bangalore is famous for its street food, snacks, and desserts. Some of the best dishes to try in Bangalore are dosa, idli, vada, chutney, sambar, bisi bele bath, ragi mudde, filter coffee, chaat, pav bhaji, momos, biryani, kebabs, rolls, ice cream, and cakes.
